function.description: Report your own runtime state: health (credit sentinel, open asks, blocked goals, suppressed owner messages, dead loops), what runs next, steps used (of the cap), active tools, context usage, and wallet/ledger balance. Read-only. Set release_notes to 'unreleased' (what changed since the last release), 'since_previous' (what changed since the previous deploy), 'latest' or a version ('1.2.0') to read instead what shipped, from the CHANGELOG.md shipped with your code. Set tool to a tool id to read why that tool is missing: its status, remedy, who can fix it and when the fix applies. Set view='refusals' for the last n gate refusals, each reason word for word (the owner's /why), view='log' for the event log: counts by kind and the newest n rows over window ('24h', '7d'; empty = all time), view='health' for the install checks (extras, packs, browser, db schema, data home, sandbox), or view='models' for the models you may name for a sub-agent, with prices.
function.name: agent_status
